description: Set an element's value by element_index, by role: text fields (whole value; AXSecureTextField never echoes the value), checkboxes / switches / radio buttons (true|false, idempotent: nothing sent when already so; a mixed checkbox is pressed up to twice until it reaches the requested state), disclosure triangles and expandable rows (true|false), rows / cells / tabs (true selects), pop-up buttons, menu buttons and combo boxes (an option's title: opens the menu, picks the one matching option, closes it again if none or several match), sliders / steppers (a number within min-max). Semantic only (no pointer); verified by reading back.
name: mac_set_value
